offers_products.reason: Sells regulated electricity delivery and generation service; utilities are treated as services, not goods.

offers_services.reason: Regulated electric utilities PNM and TNMP generate, transmit and distribute electricity to customers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: PNM serves roughly 550,000 residential and business customers; homes are among the main buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Serves businesses as customers; TNMP delivers power to retail electric providers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing monthly electric utility service to about 800,000 homes and businesses.

cyclical_demand.reason: Electricity is an essential regulated utility service that customers cannot easily cut back.

big_ticket.reason: Customers pay small, frequent monthly electricity bills.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from generation plants, transmission lines and substations, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are residential and small business customers, plus retail electric providers in Texas.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns generation, thousands of miles of transmission and distribution lines, and hundreds of substations.

notes: Electricity could be seen as a product, but utilities count as services here.
